newsitem.title: WESTERN SAMOA: RUGBY UNION-W.SAMOA CRUSH TONGA TO WIN FINAL PLACE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-W.SAMOA CRUSH TONGA TO WIN FINAL PLACE.

text.p: Flying Western Samoan winger Afato So'oalo raced to a hat-trick of tries as his team handed Tonga a 62-13 test thumping in the Pacific tri-series tournament on Saturday.
So'oalo's blinding speed left the stunned Tongan defence standing. While all his tries came late in the game, it was virtually over for the visitors by half-time with the Samoans taking a 31-3 lead.

Samoan tight head prop Robbie Ale crashed over from a lineout in the opening minutes to put the first points on the board. With the Samoan forwards providing plenty of ball, Tonga were forced to defend for long spells.
They replied with penalties either side of the break and a try in the dying seconds of the game.
Western Samoa now host Fiji in the tournament final next week.
